lines.text: Jesus heals a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and the astounded crowds ask if He is the Son of David.
The Pharisees say Jesus drives out demons by Beelzebul, and Jesus says a kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste.
Jesus says that if He drives out demons by the Spirit of God, the kingdom of God has come, and a strong man must first be set free.
Jesus says every sin will be forgiven men, but blasphemy against the temple will not be forgiven.
Jesus says a tree is known by its fruit, and men will give an account for every careless word on judgment day.
